Source: Exploiting variations across artificial regions (i.e., grids of 50x50km) within an ethnicity's historical homeland, we document that both the intensive and extensive margins of contemporary conflict are concentrated close to historical ethnic borders.
Luganda: Nga tutunuulira enjawukana mu bitundutundu ebitali bya butonde (kwe kugamba, enkoloboze eza 50x50km) mu bitundu by’amawanga binnansangwa, twakizuula nti obukuubagano obutonotono n’obw’amaanyi obuliwo mu kiseera kino businga kubeera kumpi n’ensalo z’amawanga zinnansangwa.
Yoruba: Ìlòkulò àwọn ìyàtọ̀ káàkiri sí àwọn àgbègbè àtawọ́dá (i.e gírídù ti 50x50km) láàárín ìtàn ilẹ̀ ẹ̀yà, a ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ nípa ìfọkànsí àti fífẹ ààlà méjèèjì nípa ìkọlura àwùjọ lóde òní wà ní ìdojúkọ tí ó súmọ́ tí ìtàn ààlà ẹ́lẹ̀yámẹ̀yà.
Zulu: Sisebenzisa ukuhlukahlukana ezindaweni mbumbulu (njengokuthi, amagridi angama-50x50km) ezweni lobuhlanga langaphambilini, sibhala ukuthi yomibili imiphetho ejulile nebanzi yezingxabano zamanje zigxile eduze nemingcele yaphambilini yobuhlanga.
Hausa: Yin amfani da bambance-bambance a cikin yankuna na wucin gadi (watau grid na 50x50km) a cikin mahaifar tarihi ta ƙabila, mun rubuta cewa duka manyan ɓangarorin rikice-rikice na zamani sun ta'allaƙa ne kusa da iyakokin ƙabilanci na tarihi.
Northern Sotho: Go lekodišiša ka go tsenelela dipharologantšho go kgabaganya dilete tša maitirelo (ke gore, dikiriti tša 50x50km) go dinagamagae tša semorafe tša kgale, re ngwadile gore magomo a ka gare le a ka ntle a thulano a bjale a beile šedi kgauswi le mellwane ya kgale ya semorafe.

Source: Following a theory-based instrumental variable approach, which generates a plausibly exogenous ethno-spatial partition of Africa, we find that grid cells with historical ethnic borders have 27 percentage points higher probability of conflict and 7.9 percentage points higher probability of being the initial location of a conflict.
Luganda: Nga tukozesa enkola eyeesigamizibbwa ku mutetenkanyirizo, ng’eno esobozesa okugabanya Afirika mu bitundu ebiri ebweru w’amawanga ga nnansangwa, tukizudde ng’obubookisi obuli mu nsalo z’amawanga zinnansangwa bulina emikisa gy’okubaamu obukuubagano egisingako emirundi 27 ku kikumi n’emikisa egisingako emirundi 7.9 ku kikumi egy’okuba nga bwali bubaddemu obukuubagano emabega.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú ìlò ìgbésẹ̀ ṣísẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé tí ó jẹ mọ́ tíọ́rì, tí ó ń bí ìdàgbàsókè àṣà àwùjọ kọ̀ọ̀kan tí ó fa ìpínyà Áfíríkà, A ri pé àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì tí wọ́n ní ìlà kan náà lórí máàpù tí wọ́n ní orísun ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà máa ń sábà ní ìkọlura tó tó ìdá 27 àti wọ́n jẹ́ ààyè ibi tí ìkọlura ti kọ́kọ́ ṣẹlẹ̀ rí ní ìdá 7.9.
Zulu: Silandlela eguquguqukayo yensimbi esekwe embonweni, eyenza ukwahlukaniswa kwe-Afrika kwe-ethno-spatial kwangaphandle, sithola ukuthi amaseli egridi anemingcele yomlando wobuhlanga anamaphesenti angama-27 amathuba aphezulu okungqubuzana kanye namaphesenti angama-7.9 amathuba aphezulu okuba indawo yokuqala ukungqubuzana.
Hausa: A bin ra’in madaidaicin tsarin kayan aiki, wanda yake haifar da ƙabilancin-sarari na rabuwar Afirka daga waje, mun gano cewa ginshiƙan sel waɗanda suke da iyakoki na tarihi na da kason maki 27 mafi girman yiwuwar rikice-rikice da kason maki 7.9 mafi girman yiwuwar kasancewa farkon wuri na farkon rikici.
Northern Sotho: Go latela mokgwa wa phapantšho wo o nago le mohola wo o theilwego godimo ga teori, wo o tšweletšago kgaogantšho ya dinaga go ya ka semorafe ye go dumelwago gore e na le khuetšo ya go tšwa ntle ya Afrika, re hwetša gore disele tša keriti tša mellwane ya semorafe ya kgale di na le dintlha tša diphesente tše 27 tša kgonagalo ya godingwana tša thulano le dintlha tša diphesente tše 7.9 tša godingwana tša go ba lefelo la mathomo la thulano.
